title: mini foil loaf pans
text: mini foil loaf pans. These are mini foil loaf pans... about 6" long... about 2 1/2"  deep.  They arrived quickly (I have prime) and in good condition.  I could not locate locally - so this made sense.  I used them to make mini meatloaves and froze them in pan.  They come with clear plastic tops - the tops don't stay on terribly well.. but I used foil to cover the meatloaf and then pop on the clear tops when I gave them away.  Super handy for holiday bread too.
